title: Liouville Quantum Duality and Random Planar Maps II
summary: This is Part II of our project on block-weighted planar maps and Liouville quantum duality. Focusing on the scaling properties at the dual critical point, we derive the conditional distribution of the root block size given the total size, as well as, conversely, the distribution of the total size for a fixed root block size. We show that these laws are in perfect agreement with the results of Liouville quantum gravity (LQG), obtained by modifying the standard Liouville random measure with additional atomic contributions representing localized quantum areas.
